sections.what_happened: Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf cancelled his trip to New Delhi to attend the BRICS Parliamentary Forum (12th meeting, Oct 26-27, Central Hall of Samvidhan Sadan) due to 'unforeseen circumstances'. The Iranian Embassy in India confirmed the cancellation and said a parliamentary delegation from Tehran would participate instead.

sections.what_disputed: No reason beyond 'unforeseen circumstances' was given; whether the cancellation connects to the Sunday strike/deal fork is speculation, not stated by the embassy.
sections.why_matters: Tehran's parliament speaker just pulled out of the BRICS forum in Delhi -- 'unforeseen circumstances' -- on the weekend Trump named for a strike or a deal. The delegation still goes; the speaker does not.
